findings.title: The side-pick window comes once for a whole Logic Dive: the first pick is counted for every later question and no control changes it
findings.surface: Side-pick window of a participant with no token in the hall
findings.what_happens: offerSidePick draws the window once for the key `${floor.mode}|${zone.openedAt}` and never once zone.picks holds a side for the student. zone-machine.mjs diveQuestion puts a Logic Dive's next question on the floor through phase(), whose patch names the question, the answers, the counts and the set: openedAt and picks stay. sidesNow reads the kept pick for a student with no hall token, so the answer given to question 1 is counted on questions 2 to 5. The machine would take another pick (only the same side is refused, DRPG.Zones.samePick), but requestTrialSide has one caller, this window.
findings.failure_scenario: A player whose student has no token in the hall picks Zone A on question 1 of a three-question Logic Dive; on questions 2 and 3 no window comes, the student is still counted in Zone A, and that one count can make the tie or the wrong majority that ends the set.
findings.expected: The window offered again at each new question (or a control to change the pick while the vote runs), or the picks cleared with the question.
findings.refutation_tried: git grep requestTrialSide and 'trial.side' in scripts/ (one caller, offerSidePick; the bridge row and its run); read zone-machine.mjs phase() and diveQuestion for a reset of picks or openedAt (none; zoneStart alone sets both, :161); looked for another side control in the HUD and the Events panel by the request's name (none); docs/dev/e73/STATUS.md:24-25 and both handbooks say only that such a participant 'gets a window to pick a side'; no owner's decision for once a set was found.
findings.probe: Scenario 68's fixture with one participant's student left without a hall token: start a Logic Dive of two questions (game.drpg.startLogicDive), on that player's page press `.drpg-side-pick footer button[data-action="a"]`, let question 1 be judged right, then read on that page `document.querySelector(".drpg-side-pick")` (by this reading: null) and on the GM `await game.drpg.zoneSides()` (the student still in a).

findings.title: Cancel, the X or Escape on the side-pick window leaves the participant with no way to pick in that mode, and nothing says so
findings.surface: Side-pick window of a participant with no token in the hall
findings.what_happens: pickOpenFor is set before the window is drawn. A Cancel, the header's close or Escape answers 'cancel' or null and the function returns with no notice. Every later render of the floor finds pickOpenFor equal to the key and returns at :438, and no other control asks 'trial.side', so the student stands on neither side until the mode ends; a reload of the page, which clears the module's memory, is the one road back (read in the code). The ballot's same case tells the player and leaves the GM 'Send another ballot'.
findings.failure_scenario: A participant with no hall token presses Escape as the window opens during a Straw Poll: no notice, no window again, and the console lists their student under 'In neither zone' for that count.
findings.expected: A notice as the ballot's, and a way back: the window offered again, or a control of the player's or the GM's that opens it.
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for a second caller of offerSidePick (onZoneFloor alone, :563), for a write that clears pickOpenFor (none), for a GM's resend like the vote's remind (none for the sides), and for a notice on this road (none; the only notice is DRPG.Zones.pick.done after a yes, :457).
findings.probe: On a token-less participant's page during a Straw Poll press `.drpg-side-pick footer button[data-action="cancel"]`; move the floor from the GM (the bar's +30 s) so the floor renders again; read on the player's page `document.querySelector(".drpg-side-pick")` (null) and the notices shown (none).

findings.title: Save the set judges the form after the editor has closed: an incomplete set is refused by a toast and everything typed is gone (Enter in any field presses Save)
findings.control: Save the set (the picker's Start has the same shape)
findings.what_happens: The primary's callback only reads the form (readSetForm) and the window closes on that press; saveDiveSet then asks setRefusal and, for a set with no name, no question, a blank answer or an unmarked right answer, warns and answers null. The button is enabled whatever the form holds, and as the footer's first submit button it is what Enter in any of the 17 text fields presses. Nothing keeps what was typed: New set opens empty again and Edit opens the stored set. The picker's Start is judged the same way after its window closed (zoneArgsRefusal), with a question and two answers at stake.
findings.failure_scenario: A GM types a set's name and four questions, leaves one 'Right answer' unmarked (or presses Enter after the name), and the window closes on 'Mark the right answer of every question.': the set is not saved and the text is gone.
findings.expected: The refusal made while the window is open - Save held with the reason, as the ballot holds Cast and the verdict holds 'They got it wrong' - or the editor opened again with what was typed.
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for a check inside the callback (readSetForm only reads), for `required` on the fields (none), for a reopening with the typed values after a refusal (editDiveSet hands back saveDiveSet's null; the list's handler only redraws the list, :351-353). The Save tooltip does name what a set needs (DRPG.Tips.Sweep.Trial.diveSetSaveTooltip), which warns and holds nothing. That a footer press closes a DialogV2 before the wait answers is the kit's statement (ui-kit.mjs:201-206) and the harness's model (shim.mjs:1732), not read off v14's source.
findings.probe: `await game.drpg.editDiveSet()` on the GM, type a name only, press `footer button[data-action="save"]`: the window is gone, one warning notice, and `game.drpg.openDiveSets()` lists no new set.

findings.title: Start with Logic Dive picked and no set closes the window and says nothing
findings.what_happens: With no set in the store the Logic Dive fields draw 'No Logic Dive set yet.' and no select, so the callback reads setId as an empty string. openZonePicker then answers null without calling startLogicDive, whose own check would have said 'Pick a Logic Dive set.' (trial-zones.mjs:250). The window closes and no notice is shown.
findings.evidence: if (asked.mode === ZONE_MODES.dive) return asked.setId ? startLogicDive(asked.setId) : null;
findings.failure_scenario: A GM picks Logic Dive with no set saved (or with the list stale, finding 5) and presses Start: the window closes, no mode starts, no notice.
findings.expected: Start held with its reason while Logic Dive has no set, or the warning DRPG.Zones.noSet.
findings.refutation_tried: The body does say 'No Logic Dive set yet.' before the press, which is the only word on it; startZone's warnings are not reached on this road (trial-zones.mjs:261-277 is never called); the one test that opens the picker (tier 2 'planned minigames ...') has a set.
findings.probe: In a Class Trial with zones and an empty diveSets store: `game.drpg.openZonePicker("dive")`, press `footer button[data-action="start"]`; read the notices (none) and `game.settings.get("danganronpa-rpg", "trialQueue")` (unchanged).

findings.title: The picker's set list is drawn once: a set made, changed or deleted through its own 'Logic Dive sets...' button is not in the picker until it is opened again
findings.what_happens: The button opens the sets' window beside the picker, which stays open with the select and the replay warnings it drew at its opening. openZonePicker passes no live option and nothing repaints the select when the store changes. A new set cannot be chosen, a deleted set can still be chosen (Start then finds no question and warns 'The mode did not start...'), and a set whose questions changed keeps its old count in the option.
findings.failure_scenario: A GM opens Hall zones on Logic Dive, presses 'Logic Dive sets...', writes a set and saves it; back in the picker the text still reads 'No Logic Dive set yet.' (or only the older sets are listed), and Start does nothing (finding 4) or starts an older set.
findings.expected: The select and the warnings drawn again when the sets' window closes or the store changes, or the picker closed when the sets' window opens.
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for `live:` in openZonePicker (none), for a hook or a store watch in the file that redraws the picker (none: paint only toggles `hidden` and the hint, :294-303), and for the picker closing on the button (the listener only opens the other window).
findings.probe: With an empty diveSets store open the picker on Logic Dive, press `[data-drpg-dive-edit]`, then 'New set', fill one valid question and save; read the picker's `select[name="setId"]` (absent) and its text ('No Logic Dive set yet.').

findings.title: Save on a Finding's words does nothing and says nothing for an empty field or unchanged words, and a Finding typed as the word cancel is read as Cancel
findings.what_happens: Save answers the field's text and Cancel answers its action, 'cancel', so askFindingText tells them apart by the string alone. An empty text is handed on: addFinding is not called (:420) and editFinding answers false for empty or unchanged words (:426), each with no notice, after the window has closed. A text of exactly 'cancel' is dropped at :388.
findings.failure_scenario: A GM presses Edit on a Finding, clears the field and presses Save: the window closes, the Finding stands as it was, no card and no notice.
findings.expected: Save held while the field is empty, or a notice; Cancel told apart from a text by its own answer.
findings.refutation_tried: Read the callback (`?? ""`: an empty field is a string, not a cancel), both callers' guards and the two writers for a notice on these roads (none; the public card is posted only after a write, trial-zones.mjs:400-404).
findings.probe: `game.drpg.openFindings()` with one Finding; press its `[data-drpg-finding-act="edit"]`, empty the field, press `footer button[data-action="ok"]`; read the record's findings, the chat and the notices (all unchanged).

findings.title: Apply with nobody as the Mastermind and a room picked stores nothing and says nothing
findings.what_happens: With no Mastermind set the window still offers 'The Mastermind's room'. Apply with '- nobody set -' returns before the room is read, though the GMs' record keeps the room apart from the pick (setMastermindLair :281-286). The window closes with no notice, and opened again the room reads '- no room -'.
findings.failure_scenario: A GM setting a season up picks the room first, leaves the Mastermind for later and presses Apply: nothing is stored and nothing tells them.
findings.expected: The room stored, or a line that a room needs a Mastermind first.
findings.refutation_tried: Read setMastermindLair (the record can hold a room with no pick), the who select's tooltip ('Applying with nobody set clears the Mastermind', which says nothing of the room) and the room's note; no notice is posted on this road.
findings.probe: With no Mastermind set: `game.drpg.mastermindDialog()`, choose a room in `select[name="lair"]`, press `footer button[data-action="save"]`; read the notices (none), then open the window again and read the select ('- no room -').

not_established: Every reading here is the source's (and the tests' and scenarios' named per control); no harness run, probe or real Foundry was used by this reader. audit/gate/local-gate.json for 1.2.118 lists its 8 parts as not-run (no server), so the tier 2 tests cited are not a reading on a real Foundry for this commit.

Whether Foundry v14's DialogV2 keeps a `<form>` the content brings as a nested form. The module's windows write `<form>` in their bodies and hand DialogV2 a bare div (utils.mjs dialogContent); the harness's DialogV2 parses that into its own form (shim.mjs:1740-1745) and the kit's notes on Enter assume one form. verdict.mjs read (:350-363) asks the window's first form for `executed` and `blackened` by name, which resolves only if the fields belong to that form. A reading that settles it: on a real v14 open the verdict window and evaluate `document.querySelectorAll(".application.drpg-panel form").length` and `document.querySelector(".application.drpg-panel form").executed`.

The side-pick window, the Logic Dive sets list, the set editor's Save, the Findings rows and the mask question are pressed by no test, scenario or probe found (git grep of their selectors in scripts/tests*.mjs and audit/harness: 0 hits; docs/dev/e73/STATUS.md:213 for the side-pick window); findings 1-6 are source readings, each with the press that would confirm it.

Season setup's Save held by the scenes part when the trial hall is changed during a running trial: the reason is put on the disabled button as aria-label with an empty data-tooltip (season-setup.mjs:1280-1290) and is not a line of the warnings box (trial-scene.mjs:1513-1521 draws only the same-scene clash there). Whether Foundry's tooltip shows over a disabled button at a table is not read (ui-kit.mjs:112-114 says v14's tooltip over a disabled button was not tried); season-setup.mjs is another reader's file.

The mask question is asked from a token's redraw (refreshToken, mask-gm.mjs:692-695) or at ready: on a browser that draws no canvas, or shows a scene none of whose tokens is redrawn, when the question and the voice tile's button appear was not established (LIVE-E69-05's ground).

The Mastermind window's Give writes to the Mastermind read when the window opened (wireMastermindGive's `current`, mastermind.mjs:697), while the readout redraws from the record as it is now (:521-523): after another GM changes the pick under an open window the two differ. A two-GM road, belonging to the windows' refresh pass; not followed further.

trial-scene.mjs was read in part (640-789, 900-1019, 1210-1718 of 1718 lines: the doors, the scenes part and its Apply); its hall staging, cast store and token watches hold no control and were not read whole.
